description: SE student at SSUET (Karachi) with experience in Python, FastAPI, LangChain, RAG and ML. I'm building The Earth Information Jukebox: a web app that turns NASA temperature and rainfall data into music, so people can hear our planet change. I'll handle data, backend and sonification. Need a JavaScript frontend dev, a music/Tone.js enthusiast, and a UI/UX or video editor. Beginners welcome!
